'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Steve Baroni DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck name '''Dry Clean Only'''. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

== Transcription notes ==

* Lines marked ''(illegible)'' could not be read on the scan; the sheet's partial text is shown.
* Lines 13–14 are written "Cyborg Commander" with the (V) box checked; no card by that name was found.
* Lines 36–38 are We Must Accelerate Our Plans; their (V) boxes are scribbled over, and line 38 is struck through on the sheet.
* Line 21 begins "load" or "lord"; the rest of the line and its ditto on line 22 are illegible.
* Line 9 is written "Mara w/ Light" with the (V) box checked; the card could not be identified for certain.
* Shield 10 is written "Weapon of Sith"; the shield could not be identified.
* Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
